reading.title: Council of Europe Adopts Landmark Convention on Series Co-Production — First International Legal Framework for TV & Streaming
reading.text:
On November 27, 2025, the Council of Europe officially adopted the final text of the Convention on the Co-production of Audiovisual Works in the Form of Series — the first international legal framework specifically dedicated to the independent co-production of serial content for television and streaming platforms. The decision addressed a long-recognized legal gap: while feature films had benefitted from dedicated co-production rules for decades under the 1992 Cinematographic Co-production Convention, revised in 2017, no equivalent international instrument had ever existed for serialized formats.

The new Convention introduces a distinct set of co-production rules tailored to multi-episode and multi-season production structures. On the rights side, a qualifying 'official' co-production under the Convention guarantees each independent co-producer an ownership share of rights to the finished work, proportionate to their financial contribution and creative and technical expenditures. Critically, 'in perpetuity' rights deals will not be permitted under the framework, and broadcasters and streamers must provide audience data to all co-producing parties — a significant transparency obligation specifically targeting streaming platforms.

For financial qualification, bilateral co-productions between companies from two signatory countries require the minority party to contribute at least 10% of the total budget. In multilateral co-productions involving three or more countries, the minimum contribution threshold drops to 5%, while a single party's share may not exceed 80%. Where a party is not a signatory to the Convention, their participation in the project cannot exceed 30% of the overall budget. Each season of a series is judged independently for qualification purposes, and the Convention applies equally to scripted, documentary, and animation works of any episode length, destined for any platform.

The Convention was developed following a pilot programme involving 22 donor institutions from 21 Council of Europe member states. It opened for signature during a ceremony at Series Mania in Lille on March 26, 2026, hosted by Council of Europe Secretary General Alain Berset. The Convention will enter into force once three countries have ratified it. By streamlining administrative procedures, clarifying ownership and rights obligations, and establishing predictable rules for revenue sharing, it aims to reduce transaction risk and improve planning certainty for cross-border international series productions — a goal long sought by independent co-producers navigating fragmented bilateral treaty regimes.

vocabulary.definition_cn: 符合国际条约规定标准、经主管机构认定的正式合拍项目，可享受税收优惠、资金支持及国民待遇等法律利益。
vocabulary.example: Only projects that meet the financial thresholds and creative criteria set by the Convention qualify as an official co-production entitled to treaty benefits.

vocabulary.definition_cn: 已正式签署国际条约或公约的主权国家，由此承担条约规定的法律义务并享有相应权利。
vocabulary.example: Producers from non-signatory countries may not hold more than 30% of the budget in a project structured under the Convention.

vocabulary.definition_cn: 两个主权国家之间依据双边合拍条约开展的联合制作项目，双方各自享有版权归属及市场准入方面的对等权利。
vocabulary.example: Under bilateral co-productions governed by the Convention, the minority party must contribute no less than 10% of the total production budget.

vocabulary.definition_cn: 三个或三个以上国家依据多边条约共同出资、联合制作的项目，各方须满足最低出资比例要求且任一方出资不得超过规定上限。
vocabulary.example: In multilateral co-productions involving four signatory countries, no single party's financial contribution may exceed 80% of the aggregate budget.

vocabulary.definition_cn: 合拍各方依据其资金投入及创意技术贡献比例，在已完成作品中依法享有的产权份额，直接影响收益分配与链权完整性。
vocabulary.example: The Convention mandates that each co-producer receive an ownership share proportionate to their creative and financial contribution to the series.

vocabulary.definition_cn: 指授权期限无限期延续、永不终止的权利转让安排；本公约明确禁止此类条款以保护合拍方的长期权益。
vocabulary.example: The Convention expressly prohibits in perpetuity rights deals, ensuring that co-producers retain the ability to reclaim or renegotiate their interests over time.

vocabulary.definition_cn: 条约或公约规定的合拍方须达到的最低资金投入比例，低于该门槛则不符合官方合拍资格，无法享受相关法律保障。
vocabulary.example: Failure to meet the minimum contribution threshold of 5% will disqualify a party from being recognized as a full co-producer under the multilateral framework.

vocabulary.definition_cn: 指主权国家经国内立法程序正式批准国际条约，使其对该国产生法律约束力，是条约生效的必要前提条件。
vocabulary.example: The Convention will not enter into force until it has been ratified by at least three member states of the Council of Europe.

vocabulary.definition_cn: 合同或法律框架要求一方向另一方披露特定信息（如受众数据或财务数据）的法律义务，违反则可能导致违约责任。
vocabulary.example: The Convention imposes a transparency obligation on broadcasters and streamers to share audience data with all co-producing parties.

vocabulary.definition_cn: 正式制度建立前以有限规模试验性运行的先导项目，其实践结果通常作为制定正式法律框架的实证依据。
vocabulary.example: The results of the pilot programme involving 22 donor institutions provided the empirical foundation upon which the Convention's procedural rules were drafted.

sentence_patterns.pattern: [Convention / Statute] will not enter into force until [condition precedent] has been satisfied.
sentence_patterns.example: The Convention will not enter into force until it has been ratified by at least three signatory countries.
sentence_patterns.translation_cn: 该公约在至少三个签署国完成批准程序之前不会生效。

sentence_patterns.pattern: [Party] must contribute no less than [minimum contribution threshold] of [budget / total], failing which [legal consequence].
sentence_patterns.example: In bilateral co-productions, the minority party must contribute no less than 10% of the total budget, failing which the project will not qualify as an official co-production under the Convention.
sentence_patterns.translation_cn: 在双边合拍项目中，少数方须承担不低于总预算10%的资金投入，否则该项目将不符合公约规定的官方合拍资格。

sentence_patterns.pattern: The [instrument] imposes a [transparency obligation / disclosure duty] on [obligated party] to [specific action] in favor of [beneficiary party].
sentence_patterns.example: The Convention imposes a transparency obligation on broadcasters and streamers to provide audience data to all co-producing parties.
sentence_patterns.translation_cn: 该公约对广播机构和流媒体平台课以信息披露义务，要求其向所有合拍方提供受众数据。

summary_cn: 2025年11月，欧洲委员会正式通过《系列视听作品合拍公约》，这是全球首个专门针对电视及流媒体系列内容国际联合制作的法律框架。公约规定，双边合拍少数方须至少出资10%，多边合拍最低为5%，单一方出资上限80%；禁止"永久性"版权转让，并要求播出方向所有合拍方披露受众数据。公约经三国批准后生效，旨在降低跨境系列制作的法律风险与交易成本。
legal_analysis:
① 核心法律问题：本公约填补了国际合拍法律体系中长期存在的空白——系列内容缺乏专属国际条约框架。核心问题涉及合拍各方的版权归属、出资比例门槛的法律强制性、禁止"永久性"授权的政策合理性，以及受众数据披露义务的可执行性。

② 美国法律框架分析：美国目前依赖双边合拍条约（如美加、美英协议）及《版权法》（17 U.S.C.）确立合著作权（joint authorship）规则。在美国法下，合拍合同通常通过"inter-party agreement"明确各方的chain of title及收益分配，并借助completion guarantor管控完片风险。本公约的透明度义务与美国《证券交易法》下的信息披露逻辑高度相似，具有参考价值。

③ 对中国娱乐法律师的实践启示：中国律师参与欧洲系列合拍项目时，须关注出资比例门槛对中方制作公司资格认定的影响；在中方为非签约国主体的情形下，其份额不得超过30%的上限将直接限制中方的谈判空间。此外，禁止永久性授权的条款与中国《著作权法》中的保护性规定存在协同之处，可作为合同谈判的依据。
cn_us_comparison:
在中国法律体系下，国际合拍主要受《电影产业促进法》（2017年）、国家广播电视总局发布的《中外合作摄制电影片管理规定》以及中国与特定国家签订的双边合拍协议约束。中方合拍须经主管部门审批，且对外方出资比例及创作控制权有明确限制，版权归属依据《著作权法》（2020年修订）中合作作品的相关规定处理。

相比之下，欧洲委员会新公约采用多边框架，以最低出资门槛替代行政审批作为资格认定机制，更注重合同层面的透明度义务而非事前监管。美国则以双边条约加市场化合同为主，链权（chain of title）文件是核心合规工具，完片担保（completion guaranty）机制亦与中国的资金监管制度存在本质差异。三种体系均承认合拍各方的分权式版权归属，但在行政门槛、数据披露义务和审查机制方面存在显著差异，中国法律师参与跨境合拍时须做好体系兼容性分析。

podcast_summary.episode: Episode 94: The Series Co-Production Convention — What the Council of Europe's New Treaty Means for Global TV Deals
podcast_summary.description: 本期节目深度解析欧洲委员会2025年通过的《系列视听作品合拍公约》，主持律师带领听众逐条拆解公约核心条款：从双边与多边合拍的出资门槛差异，到禁止"永久性授权"的政策逻辑，再到对流媒体平台课以受众数据披露义务的可执行性难题。节目还邀请实务嘉宾分析该公约对中美欧三方合拍架构设计的影响，以及中国制作公司作为非签约国主体时的30%出资上限如何重塑谈判格局。
takeaways: 公约禁止"永久性"版权转让，意味着合拍各方须在合同中明确约定授权期限及续期条款，这将根本性改变现行流媒体合拍合同的起草惯例。
中国制作公司在参与欧洲系列合拍时，因中国尚未加入该公约，其出资份额将受到30%上限的硬性约束，须提前在架构设计阶段予以应对。
受众数据披露义务作为条约层面的透明度机制，为独立合拍方对抗强势平台方信息不对称问题提供了具有约束力的法律工具，值得中国律师在双边合同谈判中借鉴参考。

extended_reading.title: The International Treaty Co-Production Vehicle: Legal Framework
extended_reading.description_cn: 加拿大Mondaq法律分析文章，详细梳理国际条约合拍的链权文件、版权归属分配、Telefilm Canada审批要求及争议解决机制等核心合同与监管要素。

extended_reading.title: Sino-International Film Collaboration and Co-Production: Policy and Practice
extended_reading.description_cn: 2024年同行评审学术论文，发表于《跨国银幕》（Transnational Screens），系统分析中国跨境电影合拍的国内监管政策与双边条约框架的互动关系及实务操作。
